jobs.description:
Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.
Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

For an international and multicultural organisation based in Brussels, we are looking for an Administrative & Events Assistant to join their team.

In this role, you will be responsible for a variety of administrative and organisational tasks, while also supporting the organisation of events and activities.

 

Your responsibilities as Administrative and Events Assistant :

• Managing the general mailbox and forwarding requests to the relevant person
• Managing and organising documents through SharePoint, Teams and physical archives
• Providing administrative support to the team and ongoing projects
• Maintaining the annual calendar and keeping track of activities
• Supporting the preparation of subsidy applications
• Following up on memberships, sponsors and partners in collaboration with the accounting team
• Supporting the organisation of events: contacting venues, caterers and suppliers, requesting quotations and coordinating practical details
• Preparing meetings and ensuring everything is organised and running smoothly

Your profile as Administrative and Events Assistant : 

• Has a first experience in administration, or is a recent graduate looking to develop their experience
• Is organised, proactive and hands-on
• Is able to work independently and take initiative
• Has good common sense and a strong sense of responsibility
• Is discreet and understands the importance of confidentiality
• Enjoys organising events and making sure everything is taken care of
• Is comfortable working in a multicultural environment
• Has a very good command of English; French and Dutch are a strong asset
• Has a driving licence

Our client is a highly respected international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and client service. With a collaborative and professional culture, the firm combines high standards with a supportive working environment where people are encouraged to take ownership and make an impact.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the daily operations of the Brussels office
• Lead and support administrative and office services teams
• Oversee facilities, office maintenance, and workplace experience
• Coordinate suppliers, contractors, and external service providers
• Manage vendor relationships, tenders, and contract negotiations
• Monitor office budgets, expenses, and operational costs
• Organise office events, meetings, and internal initiatives
• Drive process improvements and operational efficiency projects
• Ensure compliance with health & safety and local regulations
• Coordinate onboarding and support employee experience initiatives
• Act as the main contact for landlords, building management, and external stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with leadership and international support teams
• Support business continuity, ESG, and office governance initiatives
• Coordinate local IT-related office needs and employee support

• Minimum 10 years of experience within a law firm, consultancy, or similar professional services environment
• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken (mandatory)
• Dutch is a strong asset
• Previous people management or team leadership experience
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset
• Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Professional, discreet, and service-driven
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office and digital tools
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8  years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.

The successful candidate will maintain positive relationships with clients, legal professionals, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the highest level of confidentiality at all times.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

 

Description

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
• Supporting billing and expense management activities.
• Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
• Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
• Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
• Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
• Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
• Providing general administrative support and assisting with ad hoc projects.
 

• Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: HR Coordinator - International Law firm - Brussels
jobs.description:
International law firm in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

You will work closely with the HR Manager on a day-to-day basis and will be responsible for the full range of operational HR activities, including both Soft HR and Hard HR responsibilities:Soft HR

• Recruitment and onboarding of new employees
• Performance management and employee development
• Training coordination
• Employee relations and engagement initiatives
• HR support and guidance to employees and managers
Hard HR

• Payroll coordination and administration
• Management of employee contracts and HR documentation
• Time and attendance follow-up
• Benefits administration
• Ensuring compliance with labour law and internal HR policies

• Minimum 3 years of experience in payroll administration or in a HR Generalist role.
• Good knowledge of Belgian labour and social legislation.
• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken and Good working knowledge of French and Dutch.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel.
• Interest in new HR systems and technologies.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with a genuine desire to support employees throughout their career journey.
• Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
• Flexible, with the ability to manage changing priorities effectively.
• Solution-oriented, proactive, and accountable.
• Ability to build trusted relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
• Positive, approachable, and collaborative personality.

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Our client is an internationally active organisation with offices across multiple countries. Their Brussels team operates in a professional, collaborative and multicultural environment where efficiency, excellent service and teamwork are key to success.As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a reliable Office Operations Assistant to help maintain smooth day-to-day office activities and provide essential administrative support.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answering calls and welcoming guests professionally.
• Provide administrative support including data entry, document preparation, proofreading and reporting.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, catering arrangements and logistics for internal meetings and events.
• Manage office supplies, kitchen stock, consumables and general workplace organisation.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries and courier services.
• Support facilities-related requests and liaise with external suppliers when needed.
• Assist with access badge administration, workspace set-up and daily office inspections.
• Prepare the office for opening and help maintain a clean, organised and professional working environment.

• You have at least 1 year of experience in administration, office coordination, reception or workplace support.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
• You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is considered an asset.
• You are highly organised, proactive and able to multitask effectively.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy supporting both colleagues and visitors.
• You are hands-on and willing to assist with practical office and facilities-related tasks.
• You are reliable, discreet and able to work independently.
• You are available to work on-site in Brussels on a part-time basis, Monday to Friday from 9AM to 1PM.

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.
 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.
 

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?
 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.

For a logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for packing employees who can work in a day shift.

You are responsible for the correct handling and shipment of incoming goods. 

You will follow a pick list to pack and sort the goods according to their destination.

 
• 
You communicate well in English and/or Dutch.

 
• 
You are available to work from 08:00 to 16:15.

 
• 
Physical work is no issue for you.

 
• 
You stay calm under pressure.

 
• 
You are able to keep a good overview of your tasks.

For a client in the metal industry, we are looking for an operator.

You will be responsible for operating the profiling line, ensuring the smooth handling of both the input and output of the machines. You will work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Your responsibilities:

• You will create registrations in MII/SAP. You retrieve production orders and transmit the required quantities and lengths to the machine. You perform the prescribed measurements, compare them with the specified tolerances, and adjust the process where necessary.

• You are responsible for packaging the finished product according to the given instructions.

• You handle the transport of finished goods using an overhead crane or forklift, including the required scanning and administrative registrations.

• You have completed a technical education and are able to operate a forklift confidently.

• A valid forklift certificate is considered a strong advantage.

• You have solid technical knowledge and/or a technical background.

• Experience with an overhead crane is a strong asset.

• You prioritize safety and quality at all times.

• You are able to work independently with a high level of reliability.

• You communicate fluently in English.

Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators

• Forklift drivers

• Loaders and unloaders

• Overhead crane operators

• Saw machine operators

• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.

• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.

• You have solid technical insight.

• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.

• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.

• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.

• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.

You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:00 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is an established family-owned company with more than 30 years of experience in the food industry, specialized in the production and processing of fresh potato products.

The company combines modern production technology with a strong focus on quality, hygiene and food safety. You will join a professional and dynamic production environment where teamwork, reliability and quality are key.

We are currently looking for an experienced and motivated Line Supervisor to join a production environment in the food industry. You will be responsible for the smooth operation of the production line and will help ensure that production runs safely, efficiently, and according to quality standards.

Your responsibilities:

 
• 
Start up and monitor the production line

 
• 
Coordinate the daily activities on the production line

 
• 
Operate and supervise production equipment

 
• 
Identify and resolve minor operational issues

 
• 
Ensure quality, safety, and hygiene standards are followed

 
• 
Work closely with operators and other production colleagues

 
• 
Operate a forklift when required

 
• 
Previous experience as a production operator; experience as a Line Supervisor / Line Leader is a strong advantage

 
• 
Forklift experience

 
• 
Willingness to work in the food production industry

 
• 
Strong sense of responsibility and ability to take the lead on the production line

 
• 
Very good command of English

 
• 
Willingness to work in a 2-shift system

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German. French is an asset.

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).
